THE WHOLE NETWORK

Solid outlines: official boundaries. Dashed outlines: approximate neighborhood areas, not official boundaries.

About the 3 approximate areas

La Latina (green), Chueca (blue), and Lavapiés (red) are schematic interpretations of the linked guides, not published boundary datasets. They connect selected street locations with straight segments; edges are not street-accurate. La Latina shows a conservative historic core. Lavapiés overlaps Embajadores; hide the green Embajadores layer to isolate it.

Official areas: Chamberí and Salamanca are districts; the other seven are barrios. Castellana lies within Salamanca, so their blue fills overlap.
Official source: Ayuntamiento de Madrid · CC BY 4.0
Retrieved 7 Nov 2026. Official boundaries reprojected, not simplified. Approximate outlines authored 7 Nov 2026 using guide descriptions and Esri street geocoding.

Amenities filters require explicit “available” evidence; unverified amenities do not count as a match.

Area matches use the approximate Airbnb pin, not the listing’s neighborhood name. Groups favor the smallest neighborhood before its district; filters include all overlapping areas, even hidden polygons. Outside our 12 areas does not mean outside Madrid.

Copies every starred Airbnb link with a short description, price, rating, reviews and cancellation summary, including stays hidden by filters.

Stars are saved only in this browser. Open a stay to star it.

Map position, visibility and filters are saved in this browser.

Coverage, pricing, and location limitations

Snapshot, not a live availability feed or booking guarantee. Prices can change, and optional extras or taxes must be reconfirmed on Airbnb. Public map positions are rounded and displayed as approximate—not verified street addresses. Nearby-station distances are straight-line estimates.

No booking, payment, host contact, or private address information is stored. Apartment complexes and multi-unit listings may represent more than one unit. No room-type filter was applied.
